content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Sandy Springs

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Document your project hours and verify your education level before applying. Granite PM Academy advisors can help you assess whether your background meets PMI's criteria.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, engage with active certified practitioners, and build the knowledge foundation required by PMI. Our course covers all five domains of the PMBOK Guide and runs on a schedule that fits working professionals.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing bootcamp coursework, submit your formal application to PMI with proof of education and project experience. Pay the associated examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on documentation requirements to ensure your submission is complete and timely.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce core concepts. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center when you feel confident. Many Sandy Springs professionals complete the exam within four to eight weeks of finishing bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: PMP® certification requires renewal every three years by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs). Pursue continuing education, volunteer leadership, or PMI membership activities to meet the PDU requirement. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning resources to help you stay current and keep your credential active.
